district: Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District
summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District to issue $321 million in bonds.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes bonds and the associated property-tax levy to fund improvements at Los Gatos High School and Saratoga High School.
tax.quote: levying approximately $30 per $100,000 assessed value ($23,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A Yes vote provides bond funding for facilities and educational spaces in the district's public high schools.
schools.quote: To maintain quality academic facilities at Los Gatos High School and Saratoga High School

tax.text: A No vote rejects the proposed bonds and associated property-tax levy.
tax.quote: levying approximately $30 per $100,000 assessed value ($23,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A No vote rejects the proposed bond funding for the district's public high schools.
